item.title: Revisiting the layout and the Blog project
item.description:
Hello dear visitor, a long time ago I had the desire to revisit the Blog layout, however, conciliate attention to my family and write are not things that could be done at the same time, because, both of them requires dedication.

Well, technically speaking, the goal was to give back to the open-source community something and so the source code is hosted on GitHub. You can use it to inspire yourself by taking this project as a solid base or even as a starting point.

item.title: CakePHP problem with mod_rewrite
item.description:
Hello, good evening. Today I had problems with CakePHP URL rewriting, and decided to share the error and how I solved it.

The problem was that when I tried to access the application’s URL through the browser, it returned the following error 404 – Not Found.

Well, first, after looking for inconsistencies in controller and action names, clearing the cache, checking whether URL rewriting was enabled in Apache, etc, I turned to Google. After some research, I found the solution in Cake’s own documentation.

item.title: Zend disable the layout and view renderer
item.description:
Some people have been asking me how to disable the layout and view renderer in Zend Framework so an action in a given controller returns only JSON. Well, to do this, just use two lines of code, as you can see below.

This first approach disables the layout and view renderer for all actions in a given controller:

public function preDispatch()
{
 $this->_helper->layout()->disableLayout();
 $this->_helper->viewRenderer->setNoRender(true);
}
